payout_value_note: $50 gift card to the referrer and $50 gift card to the friend. Up to 10 referral payouts ($500) per year.
payout_quote: When your friend opens a qualified checking account and meets all requirements, you'll both receive a $50 Amazon or pre-paid Mastercard gift card. ... There's no limit! You can earn up to $500 in gift cards per year (up to 10 referral reward payouts).
steps: Member refers a friend to 3Rivers Federal Credit Union.
Friend opens a qualified checking account (Cash Back, Dividends+, Simply Free Spending, or Classic Checking; business checking doesn't qualify).
Friend makes three deposits totaling $300+ via direct deposit or mobile check deposit within 60 days, and keeps the account active and in good standing for 60 days.
Both receive a $50 Amazon or pre-paid Mastercard gift card (chosen by the referrer) within 30 days of the friend meeting all qualifications.
catches: Gift cards (Amazon or prepaid Mastercard), not cash.
Cap: 10 referral payouts / $500 in gift cards per year.
Friend must make 3 deposits totaling $300+ via DD or mobile check deposit within 60 days and keep the account in good standing 60 days.
biggest_catch: Rewards are gift cards, not cash, capped at $500/year — and the friend must make $300 in deposits within 60 days.
eligibility: 3Rivers FCU membership (northeast/central Indiana and St. Mary's, Ohio); friend must be a new member.
timing: Referral ~5 min active; gift card within 30 days of qualifications met.
